spec.description:
Bradford Fire Protection - Tile Roof (Bradford Fireseal Party
Wall Sealer for Tiled Roofs / Fireseal FZ Tile Roof Batts) is a non-combustible
stone wool insulation product designed to seal the junction between the top of a
fire-rated party wall and concrete or terracotta roof tiles. Available as a 50mm
thick roll (4000mm x 300mm or 360mm) or 100mm x 115mm x 1200mm batts, it
compresses under the tiled roof build-up to prevent fire, sparks, and embers
from traveling between adjoining occupancies in Class 1 buildings. It delivers
high thermal stability, resisting shrinkage under extreme fire exposure, and
meets BAL-FZ bushfire standards.
features:
Non-combustible stone wool
construction complying with AS 1530.1

50mm thickness optimised for profile
depths of concrete and terracotta roof tiles

Seals top-of-wall junctions to
prevent flame and spark spread between tenancies

Outstanding resistance to
shrinkage under extreme fire conditions up to 1000°C

Certified for Bushfire
Attack Level BAL-FZ construction under tiled roofs

Water-resistant fibres that do not degrade upon contact with
moisture

Satisfies NCC / BCA Deemed-to-Satisfy provisions for Class 1
separating walls

technical.value: 4000 mm length x 300 mm or 360 mm width

1200 mm length x 115 mm
width x 100 mm thickness

Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0,
Smoke Developed: 0-1

Minimum 10% to 15% compression beneath
roof tiles

install:
Roll Fireseal 50mm Party Wall
Sealer along the top of the fire-rated party wall prior to roof tile
installation

Ensure the blanket spans the full width of the wall and
timber/steel framing

Lay roof tile battens and tiles over the sealer,
ensuring continuous 10-15% compression beneath tile profiles

Butt joints in
blanket tightly together with no gaps

Verify no void exists where tile
profiles create contours above the party wall line
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof covering is concrete or terracotta tiles (requiring 50mm
thickness)

Select width based on party wall structure (300mm standard, 360mm
for wider cavity party walls)

Measure total linear metres needed along the
top of party walls
Check if property is in a BAL-FZ bushfire attack zone
accessories: Bradford Fireseal Party Wall Batten Fillers
limitations:
Must be compressed
minimum 10-15% by roof tiles to ensure fire and smoke seal

Not suitable for
deep-rib metal roofing where 75mm is required

Must not be left exposed to
pooling water or continuous outdoor weathering

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Fire Protection - Tile Roof
(Fireseal Party Wall Sealer for Tiled Roofs) is a 50mm thick, non-combustible
stone wool blanket designed to seal the gap between the top of fire-rated party
walls and concrete or terracotta roof tiles in Class 1 buildings. It compresses
by 10-15% under tile battens and contours, creating an impenetrable barrier
against flame, hot gases, and embers. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and
rated for BAL-FZ bushfire conditions, it ensures multi-residential party wall
assemblies comply with NCC Deemed-to-Satisfy fire separation standards.
